parity_reason: A scores 30 and B scores 28, so the totals differ by 2, which is more than the allowed 1. No single criterion differs by more than 1 and neither image has a critical defect, but the total gap alone breaks parity.

reference.summary: Santa rides a green kick scooter across a snowy hill at night with a stack of wrapped gifts beside him and a full moon above; the drawing is lively and polished, but the gift stack floats with nothing holding it up.

defects.what: The stack of three presents hangs in mid-air above the scooter deck, and Santa's gloved hand only crosses in front of it without holding it
defects.where: left side, the gift stack behind Santa
defects.expected: The presents should clearly rest on the scooter deck or be held firmly in Santa's arm or hand

defects.what: The hat's tip is a very long, thin curling ribbon that rises well above the head and looks more like a streamer than part of a hat
defects.expected: The hat should end in a believable floppy tip with a pom-pom, close to the head

defects.what: The torso is very large while the legs are short and stubby, so the body looks top-heavy
defects.expected: Santa should keep a round belly but have legs long enough to stand naturally on the deck

defects.what: Santa's red arm sleeve runs across the front of the gift stack, so the two shapes overlap awkwardly
defects.where: Santa's left arm over the presents
defects.expected: The arm should either clearly hold the gifts or sit apart from them without a messy overlap

attempt.summary: Santa rides a grey kick scooter on snowy hills under a full moon, holding a small gift, with a brown gift sack nearby; the drawing is clear but simple, and the sack and gift look pasted on.

defects.what: The blue present is a flat square stuck onto the front of the sack, so it reads as a sticker rather than a gift inside or beside the sack
defects.expected: The present should look like it is poking out of the sack's opening or sitting next to it as a separate object

defects.what: The sack is a stiff, blocky shape with a square red knot on top and does not look like a soft bag full of toys
defects.expected: The sack should have a rounded, lumpy, cloth-like shape tied at the neck

defects.what: The sack sits on the far hill, apart from the scooter, so it does not seem to travel with Santa
defects.expected: The sack should ride on the scooter deck or be slung over Santa's shoulder

defects.what: Santa's arms are thin sticks and his body is a plain rectangle, so the figure looks stiff
defects.expected: Santa should have rounder, fuller arms and a belly that looks plump

defects.what: The hill line behind runs right through the sack, so the sack seems to be sinking into the background
defects.expected: The sack should sit clearly on the ground in front of the hills
